name: Dumbbell / Range Dot Plot
summary: Two values per category joined by a bar — before / after, consensus / actual, 52-week low / high with a current-price marker.
summary_zh: 每个类别两个数值以线段相连：前后对比、一致预期对比实际、52 周最低/最高价加当前股价标记。
description_zh: 每行一个类别，from 与 to 两个点之间用线段连接，线段长度即差距，颜色可按方向（上升为 pos 色、下降为 neg 色）或统一着色；可加第三个 marker 值（菱形，如当前股价）。range 变体画成带端点刻度的区间条，配合 normalize:'to' 即为经典的“当前股价占 52 周高点百分比”图。右侧可加差值列（绝对值、百分比或 marker 相对 to 的偏离），可按差距、端点或 marker 排序。
best_for: Actual vs. consensus by quarter (beat / miss)
52-week trading range with current price (% of high)
Before / after or plan / actual comparisons
avoid_when: More than two values per category (use a dot plot / bar)
Values that must be read from zero (use bar / lollipop)
Time series with many periods (use line)

marker.desc: Optional third value drawn as a diamond (current price)

highlight.desc: Boolean field marking the target row(s)

variant.desc: dumbbell (dots joined by a bar) | range (band with end ticks)

normalize.desc: null | 'to' | 'from' — plot as % of that end (e.g. % of 52-week high)

delta.desc: Right-hand column: null | 'abs' (to − from) | 'pct' (to / from − 1) | 'marker' (marker / to − 1)

deltaFormat.desc: Delta column format; default value format ('abs') or 0.0%

fromLabel.desc: Legend / tooltip name of 'from' (default: field title)

toLabel.desc: Legend / tooltip name of 'to' (default: field title)

markerLabel.desc: Legend / tooltip name of the marker (default: field title)

rangeLabel.desc: Legend name of the range band (variant 'range')

upLabel.desc: Legend name for increases with colorBy 'direction' (default 'Increase')

downLabel.desc: Legend name for decreases with colorBy 'direction' (default 'Decrease')

highlight.desc: Label value(s) to emphasise in addition to the highlight channel

highlightBand.desc: Tinted row band behind highlighted categories

zero.desc: Force the value axis to include zero

format.desc: Value format; defaults to the from field's format (0% when normalised)

interactions: Hover tooltip with change, % of high and position in range
Segments grow from 'from' to 'to' on entry; smooth re-sort on filter change

samples.title: Share price vs. 52-week range (% of 52-week high)
